# Title card burned into the talking-head edit

A title card burned into the top of the talking-head edit with mgvideo title: the name and a one-line subtitle on a dark rounded card that stays on screen for the whole clip.

- Type: Title card
- Skill: `magnifito-edit`
- Engine: `title`
- Output: 1920x1080, 7 s, with audio
- Video: [`../videos/f12-title-card.mp4`](../videos/f12-title-card.mp4)
- Footage: synthetic, generated by the commands below. No camera footage is used.

## Recreate it with Claude Code

Install the plugin (see the repository README), open this folder, and give Claude this prompt:

> Burn a title card into 7 seconds of ../videos/03-talking-head-edit.mp4 (from 2 s to 9 s): "Meet Mira from Magnifito" with the subtitle "Digital marketing agency, Sofia", placed at the top so it does not cover her face or the captions. Keep the audio and save it as work/titled.mp4.

## Recreate it by hand

From the repository root, one command renders this example exactly as committed:

```sh
npm run showcase -- f12-title-card
```

Or run the steps yourself from `showcase/f12-title-card/` (after `npm run build && npm link`):

```sh
ffmpeg -ss 2 -t 7 -i ../videos/03-talking-head-edit.mp4 -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -preset medium -c:a aac -b:a 160k work/source.mp4
mgvideo title work/source.mp4 --title "Meet Mira from Magnifito" --subtitle "Digital marketing agency, Sofia" --position top --out work/titled.mp4
```

The finished file is `work/titled.mp4`. The config files in this folder are the inputs.
